verses.sloka: इति उक्तः करुणम् वाक्यम् वानरैः त्यक्त जीवितैः ।स बाष्पो वानरान् गृध्रः प्रत्युवाच महास्वनः ॥४-५८-१॥
verses.transliteration: iti uktaḥ karuṇam vākyam vānaraiḥ tyakta jīvitaiḥ ।sa bāṣpo vānarān gṛdhraḥ pratyuvāca mahāsvanaḥ ॥4-58-1॥

translations.english: On hearing the pathetic words from the monkeys who had given up hope of life, the loudvoiced vulture wailing replied:

verses.sloka: यवीयान् मम स भ्राता जटायुः नाम वानराः ।यम् आख्यात हतम् युद्धे रावणेन बलीयसा ॥४-५८-२॥
verses.transliteration: yavīyān mama sa bhrātā jaṭāyuḥ nāma vānarāḥ ।yam ākhyāta hatam yuddhe rāvaṇena balīyasā ॥4-58-2॥

translations.english: 'O monkeys, the one you said to have been killed by mighty Ravana in a combat was my younger brother, Jatayu.

verses.sloka: वृद्ध भावात् अपक्षत्वात् शृण्वन् तत् अपि मर्षये ।न हि मे शक्तिः अद्य अस्ति भ्रातुः वैर विमोक्षणे ॥४-५८-३॥
verses.transliteration: vṛddha bhāvāt apakṣatvāt śṛṇvan tat api marṣaye ।na hi me śaktiḥ adya asti bhrātuḥ vaira vimokṣaṇe ॥4-58-3॥

translations.english: 'Even after I have heard this, I cannot avenge my brother's death as I am old, I have no wings, and I have no energy enough (to fight).
translations.hindi: सीता कहाँ है ? उसे किसने देखा और कोन उसे हर ले गया ? ये सब बातें बतला कर, आप इन वानरों के प्राण बचाइए

verses.sloka: पुरा वृत्र वधे वृत्ते स च अहम् च जय एषिणौ ।आदित्यम् उपयातौ स्वो ज्वलंतम् रश्मि मालिनम् ॥४-५८-४॥
verses.transliteration: purā vṛtra vadhe vṛtte sa ca aham ca jaya eṣiṇau ।ādityam upayātau svo jvalaṁtam raśmi mālinam ॥4-58-4॥

translations.english: 'In olden days, when Indra killed Vrutra we (Jatayu and I) seeking to challenge him reached the Sun blazing with a garland of beams.
translations.hindi: बह कोन पुरुष है, जिसने श्रीरामचन्द्र जी और लच्मण जी के धनुष से छूटे हुए, बज्र के समान वेग से जाने वाले धाणों के बिक्रम की जरा भी परवाह नहीं की

verses.sloka: आवृत्य आकाश मार्गेण जवेन स्वर् गतौ भृशम् ।मध्यम् प्राप्ते च सूर्ये च जटायुः अवसीदति ॥४-५८-५॥
verses.transliteration: āvṛtya ākāśa mārgeṇa javena svar gatau bhṛśam ।madhyam prāpte ca sūrye ca jaṭāyuḥ avasīdati ॥4-58-5॥

translations.english: 'Flying in the sky at a violently high speed, we reached the meridian of the Sun when, unable to bear the heat, Jatayu became weak.
translations.hindi: है यह्‌ सुन गृध्रराज प्रसन्न हुए और उन बानरों को घीरज वँधा, जो कि सीता का वृत्तान्त सुनने को साबधान हो तत्पर थे, यहद वचन बोले

verses.sloka: तम् अहम् भ्रातरम् दृष्ट्वा सूर्य रश्मिभिः अर्दितम् ।पक्षाभ्यम् छादयामास स्नेहात् परम विह्वलम् ॥४-५८-६॥
verses.transliteration: tam aham bhrātaram dṛṣṭvā sūrya raśmibhiḥ arditam ।pakṣābhyam chādayāmāsa snehāt parama vihvalam ॥4-58-6॥

translations.english: 'Seeing my brother tormented due to the Sun's radiance I was overwhelmed with grief. Out of love I covered him with both my wings.
translations.hindi: मैंने जैसा जानकी का हरण सुना है ओर जिसने मुझसे कदा है और जहाँ पर बह बड़े नेत्रों वाली जानकी विद्यमान है, इन सब बातों को में कहता हूँ, तुम लोग सुनो

verses.sloka: निर्दग्ध पत्रः पतितो विन्ध्ये अहम् वानरर्षभाः ।अहम् अस्मिन् वसन् भ्रातुः प्रवृत्तिम् न उपलक्षये ॥४-५८-७॥
verses.transliteration: nirdagdha patraḥ patito vindhye aham vānararṣabhāḥ ।aham asmin vasan bhrātuḥ pravṛttim na upalakṣaye ॥4-58-7॥

translations.english: 'O bulls among monkeys, consequently my wings were burnt and I dropped down on Vindhya. Here I have been living, knowing not my brother's whereabouts.'
translations.hindi: मुझे इस दुर्गम और बहुत योजनां के लंबे चोड़े पर्वत पर गिरे ति बु ~ ~ ~ w गौ हुए बहुत दिन बीत गए । अत्र तो में बहुत बूढ़ा हो गया हूँ और नेरे शरीर में न तो उत्साह ही रह गया और न पराक्रम ही

verses.sloka: जटायुषः तु एवम् उक्तो भ्रात्रा सम्पातिना तदा ।युव राजो महाप्राज्ञः प्रत्युवाच अंगदः तदा ॥४-५८-८॥
verses.transliteration: jaṭāyuṣaḥ tu evam ukto bhrātrā sampātinā tadā ।yuva rājo mahāprājñaḥ pratyuvāca aṁgadaḥ tadā ॥4-58-8॥

translations.english: To these words of Jatayu's brother, Sampati, Angada, the learned heir apparent replied:

verses.sloka: जटायुषो यदि भ्राता श्रुतम् ते गदितम् मया ।आख्याहि यदि जानासि निलयम् तस्य रक्षसः ॥४-५८-९॥
verses.transliteration: jaṭāyuṣo yadi bhrātā śrutam te gaditam mayā ।ākhyāhi yadi jānāsi nilayam tasya rakṣasaḥ ॥4-58-9॥

translations.english: 'I have heard you. If you are the brother of Jatayu, tell us about the abode of that demon if you know.

verses.sloka: अदीर्घ दर्शिनम् तम् वा रावणम् राक्षसाधिपम् ।अन्तिके यदि वा दूरे यदि जानासि शंस नः ॥४-५८-१०॥
verses.transliteration: adīrgha darśinam tam vā rāvaṇam rākṣasādhipam ।antike yadi vā dūre yadi jānāsi śaṁsa naḥ ॥4-58-10॥

translations.english: 'Tell us about Ravana, king of the demons who is unaware of the consequences. If you know his residence, tell us if it is near or far.'
translations.hindi: एक दिन की बात है सबेरा होतें ही सुपाश्व, आहार को बोज में गया और साँछ होने पर चिना साँस लिए हो रीते हाथों लौट झ्या

verses.sloka: ततो अब्रवीत् महातेजा भ्राता ज्येष्ठो जटायुषः ।आत्म अनुरूपम् वचनम् वानरान् संप्रहर्षयन् ॥४-५८-११॥
verses.transliteration: tato abravīt mahātejā bhrātā jyeṣṭho jaṭāyuṣaḥ ।ātma anurūpam vacanam vānarān saṁpraharṣayan ॥4-58-11॥

translations.english: Then Jatayu's elder brother, the glorious Sampati, said these pleasing, befitting words:
translations.hindi: बुढ़ाई के कारण में उस समय बहुत भूखा था | सो भोजन तपाने से मेने अपने पक्षिप्रवर पुत्र को बहुब्न कुछ बला बुरा कहा

verses.sloka: निर्दग्ध पक्षो गृध्रो अहम् गत वीर्यः प्लवम् गमाः ।वाङ् मात्रेण तु रामस्य करिष्ये साह्यम् उत्तमम् ॥४-५८-१२॥
verses.transliteration: nirdagdha pakṣo gṛdhro aham gata vīryaḥ plavam gamāḥ ।vāṅ mātreṇa tu rāmasya kariṣye sāhyam uttamam ॥4-58-12॥

translations.english: 'O monkeys I am a vulture. My wings are burnt and my strength is depleted. The only substantial help I can render Rama is through my words.
translations.hindi: तब वह सेरी प्रतज्ञवा को बढ़ाने वाला सुपाश्व आहार न पाने के कारण मेरे द्वारा धमकाए जाने पर बहुत दुःखी हुआ और मुझसे हमा माँग कर उसने मुझसे यह यथार्थ बात कही

verses.sloka: जानामि वारुणान् लोकान् विष्णोः त्रैविक्रमान् अपि ।देव असुर विमर्दाम् च हि अमृतस्य च मंथनम् ॥४-५८-१३॥
verses.transliteration: jānāmi vāruṇān lokān viṣṇoḥ traivikramān api ।deva asura vimardām ca hi amṛtasya ca maṁthanam ॥4-58-13॥

translations.english: 'I know Varuna's worlds(seas and oceans) and all the three worlds measured by three strides by Vamana. Indeed I also know about the friction between the great gods and demons and the churning of the ocean for nectar.
translations.hindi: हे तात! में यथासमय आंस की खोज में आकाश सें उड़ा अर सहेन्द्राचल की राह छेक कर, में खड़ा था

verses.sloka: रामस्य यत् इदम् कार्यम् कर्तव्यम् प्रथमम् मया ।जरया च हतम् तेजः प्राणाः च शिथिला मम ॥४-५८-१४॥
verses.transliteration: rāmasya yat idam kāryam kartavyam prathamam mayā ।jarayā ca hatam tejaḥ prāṇāḥ ca śithilā mama ॥4-58-14॥

translations.english: 'Rama's work is my primary duty. (But) my strength is drained by age and I have lost my vitality.
translations.hindi: में नीचे को मुँह कर के चुपचाप समुद्र के भोतर घूमने किरने वाल सहस्रं जोव जन्तुं का रास्ता रोकने का, वेठा रहा

verses.sloka: तरुणी रूप संपन्ना सर्व आभरण भूषिता ।ह्रियमाणा मया दृष्टा रावणेन दुरात्मना ॥४-५८-१५॥
verses.transliteration: taruṇī rūpa saṁpannā sarva ābharaṇa bhūṣitā ।hriyamāṇā mayā dṛṣṭā rāvaṇena durātmanā ॥4-58-15॥

translations.english: 'I saw a young lady of beautiful appearance, adorned with all kinds of ornaments borne away by the evilminded Ravana. That dainty lady was calling out, 'O Rama, O Lakshmana' and was crying aloud. She was throwing away her ornaments and was wriggling to get out of Ravana's grip.

verses.sloka: क्रोशन्ती राम राम इति लक्ष्मण इति च भामिनी ।भूषणानि अपविध्यन्ती गात्राणि च विधुन्वती ॥४-५८-१६॥
verses.transliteration: krośantī rāma rāma iti lakṣmaṇa iti ca bhāminī ।bhūṣaṇāni apavidhyantī gātrāṇi ca vidhunvatī ॥4-58-16॥

translations.english: 'I saw a young lady of beautiful appearance, adorned with all kinds of ornaments borne away by the evilminded Ravana. That dainty lady was calling out, 'O Rama, O Lakshmana' and was crying aloud. She was throwing away her ornaments and was wriggling to get out of Ravana's grip.
translations.hindi: जग 2४ र ना टी स्का सरर शि कप, धग्दारसंरोघात्‌-ग्रादवारस्याप्रापततवारदित्यथः | (शि०) २अ्रनुमान्य -- मांसंप्रा््य । ३ ग्रभ्यवद्दारार्थ--पितुरम्यवहाराथ नेष्यामीति कृतनिश्चय- इत्यर्थः ?| (रा०) *पाठास्तरें--प्रम: ”। मैंने अपने मन में यह निश्चय किआ कि, ये दोनों आज मेरे पिता के भोजन के ।लए होंगे । परन्तु उस पुरुष ने गिड़ गिड़ा कर और विनय कर मुझसे रास्ता माँगा

verses.sloka: सूर्य प्रभा इव शैल अग्रे तस्याः कौशेयम् उत्तमम् ।असिते राक्षसे भाति यथा वा तडित् अंबुदे ॥४-५८-१७॥
verses.transliteration: sūrya prabhā iva śaila agre tasyāḥ kauśeyam uttamam ।asite rākṣase bhāti yathā vā taḍit aṁbude ॥4-58-17॥

translations.english: 'Her fine silk garment was shining like the radiance of the Sun on the mountain peak, like lightning against the dark cloud. (That was Ravana).
translations.hindi: अतः मेंने उसे निकल जाने दिआ। क्योंकि मधुरभाषी जनों पर प्रहार करने वाला कदाचित्‌ ही कोई इस भूमण्डल पर निकले | यहाँ तक कि, जब नीच भी ऐसा काम नहीं करता, तब मेरे जैसा उस पर क्योंकर प्रहार कर सकता था

verses.sloka: ताम् तु सीताम् अहम् मन्ये रामस्य परिकीर्तनात् ।श्रूयताम् मे कथयतो निलयम् तस्य रक्षसः ॥४-५८-१८॥
verses.transliteration: tām tu sītām aham manye rāmasya parikīrtanāt ।śrūyatām me kathayato nilayam tasya rakṣasaḥ ॥4-58-18॥

translations.english: 'Since she was uttering Rama's name I think she is Sita. (Now) I will tell you about the demon's abode. Listen
translations.hindi: सो बह्‌ अपने तेज से आकाश का तिरस्कार करता हुआ झट पट निकल गया । तदनन्तर आकारशाचारी जीवों ने मेरी वडी प्रशंसा की

verses.sloka: पुत्रो विश्रवसः साक्षात् भ्राता वैश्रवणस्य च ।अध्यास्ते नगरीम् लंकाम् रावणो नाम राक्षसः ॥४-५८-१९॥
verses.transliteration: putro viśravasaḥ sākṣāt bhrātā vaiśravaṇasya ca ।adhyāste nagarīm laṁkām rāvaṇo nāma rākṣasaḥ ॥4-58-19॥

translations.english: 'He is Vishrava's son and halfbrother of Vaishravana. His name is Ravana and he resides in the city of Lanka.

verses.sloka: इतो द्वीपे समुद्रस्य संपूर्णे शत योजने ।तस्मिन् लंका पुरी रम्या निर्मिता विश्वकर्मणा ॥४-५८-२०॥
verses.transliteration: ito dvīpe samudrasya saṁpūrṇe śata yojane ।tasmin laṁkā purī ramyā nirmitā viśvakarmaṇā ॥4-58-20॥

translations.english: 'The beautiful city of Lanka is an island, a hundred yojanas away from here.It was built by Visvakarma.

verses.sloka: जांबूनदमयैः द्वारैः चित्रैः कांचन वेदिकैः ।प्रासादैः हेम वर्णैः च महद्भिः सुसमाकृता ॥४-५८-२१॥
verses.transliteration: jāṁbūnadamayaiḥ dvāraiḥ citraiḥ kāṁcana vedikaiḥ ।prāsādaiḥ hema varṇaiḥ ca mahadbhiḥ susamākṛtā ॥4-58-21॥

translations.english: 'The city has golden gates, golden platforms, huge, goldencoloured, uniformly built mansions surrounded by a tall boundary wall of the colour of sunlight.

verses.sloka: प्राकारेण अर्क वर्णेन महता च समन्विता ।तस्याम् वसति वैदेही दीना कौशेय वासिनी ॥४-५८-२२॥
verses.transliteration: prākāreṇa arka varṇena mahatā ca samanvitā ।tasyām vasati vaidehī dīnā kauśeya vāsinī ॥4-58-22॥

translations.english: 'You will see in the city of Lanka, the princess from Videha, daughter of Janaka, a picture of dejection, robed in silk, confined in the harem of Ravana, wellprotected by demonesses.
translations.hindi: तदनन्तर परम शोभायमान सिद्ध लोगों ने मुके बतलाया कि, बह पुरुष राक्षसों का राजा रावण था और वद स्री जिसके गहने गिरते जाते थे, जिसकी पीली रेशमी साड़ी इवा में उड़ रही थी, जिसके सिर की चोटी खुली हुई थी, जो शोकाकुल हो श्रीराम ओर लक्ष्मण का नाम ले पुकार रही थी, जनकनन्दिनी थी, जो द्‌ शरथनन्दन श्रीरामचन्द्र की भार्या थी और जिसे रावण हर कर लिये जाता था । कालल्ञों में श्रेष्ठ उस सुपाशवे ने कहा कि, हे तात ! इसीसे आज मुझे देर हो गई

verses.sloka: रावण अन्तःपुरे रुद्धा राक्षसीभिः सुरक्षिता ।जनकस्य आत्मजाम् राज्ञः तस्याम् द्रक्ष्यथ मैथिलीम् ॥४-५८-२३॥
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇa antaḥpure ruddhā rākṣasībhiḥ surakṣitā ।janakasya ātmajām rājñaḥ tasyām drakṣyatha maithilīm ॥4-58-23॥

translations.english: 'You will see in the city of Lanka, the princess from Videha, daughter of Janaka, a picture of dejection, robed in silk, confined in the harem of Ravana, wellprotected by demonesses.
translations.hindi: जव सुपाश्व ने मुझसे यह समस्त वृत्तान्त कहा, तब उसे सुन कर भी सेरी इच्छा न हुईं कि में कुछ पराक्रम कर दिखाऊ

verses.sloka: लंकायाम् अथ गुप्तायाम् सागरेण समंततः ।संप्राप्य सागरस्य अंतम् संपूर्णम् शत योजनम् ॥४-५८-२४॥
verses.transliteration: laṁkāyām atha guptāyām sāgareṇa samaṁtataḥ ।saṁprāpya sāgarasya aṁtam saṁpūrṇam śata yojanam ॥4-58-24॥

translations.english: 'O monkeys traverse a hundred yojanas across the sea. On reaching the southern coast you will be able to see Ravana's Lanka defended and surrounded by the sea. Now proceed swiftly and prove your strength.
translations.hindi: क्योंकि पंखविहं न पक्षी, भला क्या काम कर सकता है ? ' पर हाँ, जो कुछ वाणी या बुद्धिवल से मैं कर सकता हूँ, उसे सुनो । क्योंकि उसका करना तुम्हारे पोरव पर निर्भर हे में भी अपनी बाणो से ( अर्थात्‌ वचन द्वारा ) और बुद्धि के अनुसार तुम्ह री सहायता करूंगा

verses.sloka: आसाद्य दक्षिणम् तीरम् ततो द्रक्ष्यथ रावणम् ।तत्र एव त्वरिताः क्षिप्रम् विक्रमध्वम् प्लवंगमाः ॥४-५८-२५॥
verses.transliteration: āsādya dakṣiṇam tīram tato drakṣyatha rāvaṇam ।tatra eva tvaritāḥ kṣipram vikramadhvam plavaṁgamāḥ ॥4-58-25॥

translations.english: 'O monkeys traverse a hundred yojanas across the sea. On reaching the southern coast you will be able to see Ravana's Lanka defended and surrounded by the sea. Now proceed swiftly and prove your strength.
translations.hindi: वहाँ पर मैंने देखा कि काजल की तरह काले रंग का कोइ व्यक्ति उदयकालंःन सूर्य जैसी प्रभावाली एक स्त्री को लिये हुए चला जाता हे

verses.sloka: ज्ञानेन खलु पश्यामि दृष्ट्वा प्रत्यागमिष्यथ ।आद्यः पंथाः कुलिंगानाम् ये च अन्ये धान्य जीविनः ॥४-५८-२६॥
verses.transliteration: jñānena khalu paśyāmi dṛṣṭvā pratyāgamiṣyatha ।ādyaḥ paṁthāḥ kuliṁgānām ye ca anye dhānya jīvinaḥ ॥4-58-26॥

translations.english: 'By intuition I know you would see Sita and return. On the first plane you will see sparrows and birds which live on grain. On the second, you will see crows living on the food offered to the dead and birds living on the fruits of trees, and then cocks, cranes and kraunchas moving on the third plane, on the fourth, hawks and falcons and on the fifth, vultures.
translations.hindi: क्योंकि जो श्रीरामचन्द्र जी का काम है उसे में निश्चय ही अपना ही काम सममता हूँ। आप लोग भी बुद्धिमान्‌, बलवान्‌, शूर और देवताओं का भी सामना करने बाले हैं। यही समझ कर सुम्रीब ने आप लोगों को इधर भेजा हे । कङ्कपत्र युक्त श्रीराम लक्ष्मण जी के बाण भो तीनों लोकों का नाश और उद्धार (दरड और दयो) करने में समर्थ हैं । यद्यपि दशग्रीव रावण तेजस्वी ओर बलवान्‌ हे, तथापि सब कार्या को पूरा करने की साम्यं रखने वाले आप लोगों के लिये अजेय नहीं है

verses.sloka: द्वितीयो बलि भोजानाम् ये च वृक्ष फल अशिनः ।भासाः तृतीयम् गच्छन्ति क्रौन्चाः च कुररैः सह ॥४-५८-२७॥
verses.transliteration: dvitīyo bali bhojānām ye ca vṛkṣa phala aśinaḥ ।bhāsāḥ tṛtīyam gacchanti krauncāḥ ca kuraraiḥ saha ॥4-58-27॥

translations.english: 'By intuition I know you would see Sita and return. On the first plane you will see sparrows and birds which live on grain. On the second, you will see crows living on the food offered to the dead and birds living on the fruits of trees, and then cocks, cranes and kraunchas moving on the third plane, on the fourth, hawks and falcons and on the fifth, vultures.

verses.sloka: श्येनाः चतुर्थम् गच्छन्ति गृध्रा गच्छन्ति पंचमम् ।बल वीर्य उपपन्नानाम् रूप यौवन शालिनाम् ॥४-५८-२८॥
verses.transliteration: śyenāḥ caturtham gacchanti gṛdhrā gacchanti paṁcamam ।bala vīrya upapannānām rūpa yauvana śālinām ॥4-58-28॥

translations.english: 'O bulls among monkeys swans blessed with strength, vigour, beauty and youth move in the sixth region. Beyond, on the seventh plane, you will see the descendants of Garuda.

verses.sloka: षष्ठः तु पन्था हंसानाम् वैनतेय गतिः परा ।वैनतेयात् च नः जन्म सर्वेषाम् वानरर्षभाः ॥४-५८-२९॥
verses.transliteration: ṣaṣṭhaḥ tu panthā haṁsānām vainateya gatiḥ parā ।vainateyāt ca naḥ janma sarveṣām vānararṣabhāḥ ॥4-58-29॥

translations.english: 'O bulls among monkeys swans blessed with strength, vigour, beauty and youth move in the sixth region. Beyond, on the seventh plane, you will see the descendants of Garuda.

verses.sloka: गर्हितम् तु कृतम् कर्म येन स्म पिशित अशनाः ।प्रतिकार्यम् च मे तस्य वैरम् भ्रातृ कृतम् भवेत् ॥४-५८-३०॥
verses.transliteration: garhitam tu kṛtam karma yena sma piśita aśanāḥ ।pratikāryam ca me tasya vairam bhrātṛ kṛtam bhavet ॥4-58-30॥

translations.english: 'From here I see Ravana and Janaki. We (vultures) have a divine golden vision and great power.

verses.sloka: इह स्थः अहम् प्रपश्यामि रावणम् जानकीम् तथा ।अस्माकम् अपि सौपर्णम् दिव्यम् चक्षुर् बलम् तथा ॥४-५८-३१॥
verses.transliteration: iha sthaḥ aham prapaśyāmi rāvaṇam jānakīm tathā ।asmākam api sauparṇam divyam cakṣur balam tathā ॥4-58-31॥

translations.english: 'O monkeys therefore, by the strength of food and by nature we can always see beyond a hundred yojanas from this edge.

verses.sloka: तस्मात् आहार वीर्येण निसर्गेण च वानराः ।आयोजन शतात् साग्रात् वयम् पश्याम नित्यशः ॥४-५८-३२॥
verses.transliteration: tasmāt āhāra vīryeṇa nisargeṇa ca vānarāḥ ।āyojana śatāt sāgrāt vayam paśyāma nityaśaḥ ॥4-58-32॥

translations.english: 'Our movement and vision naturally extends to distant places. For those fighting on foot, the movement is restricted to the extent of foot movement.

verses.sloka: अस्माकम् विहिता वृत्तिः निसार्गेण च दूरतः ।विहिता पाद मूले तु वृत्तिः चरण योधिनाम् ॥४-५८-३३॥
verses.transliteration: asmākam vihitā vṛttiḥ nisārgeṇa ca dūrataḥ ।vihitā pāda mūle tu vṛttiḥ caraṇa yodhinām ॥4-58-33॥

translations.english: The despicable deed was done by that flesh-eating demon, and avenging my brother's enmity falls to me.

verses.sloka: उपायो दृश्यताम् कश्चित् लंघने लवण अंभसः ।अभिगम्य तु वैदेहीम् समृद्ध अर्था गमिष्यथ ॥४-५८-३४॥
verses.transliteration: upāyo dṛśyatām kaścit laṁghane lavaṇa aṁbhasaḥ ।abhigamya tu vaidehīm samṛddha arthā gamiṣyatha ॥4-58-34॥

translations.english: 'Look out for some means to cross the salty ocean. You will see Vaidehi, and return, your mission accomplished.

verses.sloka: समुद्रम् नेतुम् इच्छामि भवद्भिः वरुण आलयम् ।प्रदास्यामि उदकम् भ्रातुः स्वर् गतस्य महात्मनः ॥४-५८-३५॥
verses.transliteration: samudram netum icchāmi bhavadbhiḥ varuṇa ālayam ।pradāsyāmi udakam bhrātuḥ svar gatasya mahātmanaḥ ॥4-58-35॥

translations.english: 'Take me to the ocean, the abode of Varuna. I intend to offer oblation to my brother, a great soul who is in heaven.'

verses.sloka: ततो नीत्वा तु तम् देशम् तीरे नद नदी पतेः ।निर्दग्ध पक्षम् संपातिम् वानराः सुमहौओजसः ॥४-५८-३६॥
verses.transliteration: tato nītvā tu tam deśam tīre nada nadī pateḥ ।nirdagdha pakṣam saṁpātim vānarāḥ sumahauojasaḥ ॥4-58-36॥

translations.english: Th mightiest of monkeys carried Sampati, whose wings were totally burnt, to the sea shore and after he had offered oblations took him back to the same place. Having obtained all information from the king of vultures the monkeys were very happy. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे अष्टपञ्चशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftyeighth sarga in Kishkindakanda of the first epic, the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

verses.sloka: तम् पुनः प्रत्यानयित्वा वै तम् देशम् पतग ईश्वरम् ।बभूवुः वानरा हृष्टाः प्रवृत्तिम् उपलभ्य ते ॥४-५८-३७॥
verses.transliteration: tam punaḥ pratyānayitvā vai tam deśam pataga īśvaram ।babhūvuḥ vānarā hṛṣṭāḥ pravṛttim upalabhya te ॥4-58-37॥
